target: Transfer the historical graph-tautology Formula-Caching lower bound to JANUS-FC_local with Policy-0A's deterministic one-pass local Resolution rule.

residual_raw_order_witness.failure_mode: A local pass can falsify every critical total order compatible only with the reconstructed entry assignment at internal states; raw compatible-order mass is not the historical lower-bound invariant.

historical_target_frontier.measure: Novel branches joining different connected components of the current partial-order Hasse diagram.

graphic_rank_accounting.branch_lemma: A non-novel branch does not lower clause graphic rank; a novel branch lowers it by at most one while increasing novelty by one.
graphic_rank_accounting.resolution_lemma: One Resolution inference lowers graphic rank by at most one.
graphic_rank_accounting.interpretation: A shortcut skipping d independent joins requires at least d explicit rank-losing Resolution events in its ancestry.

frozen_parent_space.interpretation: The finite protection is structural and does not depend on pair order, width stopping, or addition budget.

bridge_pair_geometry.corrected_obstruction: A same-cut double-bridge pair is the only graph-rank route to an unsafe resolvent, but no such pair occurs through GT_8.

canonical_root_shield.conditional_lemma: For l:a->b, singleton component(a) leaves N_a untouched; a merged component(b) supplies a quotient-parallel complement b->a, so -l is non-bridge.

temporal_parent_eligibility.one_pass_rule: Fresh resolvents are emitted but are not re-indexed as parents during the same local pass.

singleton_tail_handoff.interpretation: The arbitrary-n handoff must use the exact lexicographic selector (-frequency, variable_index), not a frequency-only inequality.

merged_tail_extinction.corrected_statement: Merged-tail extinction is a disjunction: causal post-unit conflict, recursive extinction, or a separately proved structural-safety transition.

proved_local_lemmas: One-step Resolution rank loss is at most one.
Complementary tail-singleton bridges isolate opposite endpoints and therefore induce different cuts.
Singleton tail plus merged head activates an untouched root non-minimality shield.
Fresh local resolvents are not parent-eligible during their birth pass.

remaining_theorem_gates.name: Merged-Tail Extinction Disjunction
remaining_theorem_gates.statement: For arbitrary n, every fresh non-tail bridge with non-singleton tail is causally consumed by contradiction, eliminated in every recursive child, or transformed into a safe structure before a later parent-eligible exact key.

remaining_theorem_gates.name: Lexicographic Singleton-Tail Handoff
remaining_theorem_gates.statement: For arbitrary n, every surviving singleton-tail bad lineage is branched away from the tail by the exact (-frequency, variable_index) selector, and a singleton head is merged before the next parent-eligible key.

remaining_theorem_gates.name: Global Cache-Frontier Transfer
remaining_theorem_gates.statement: Transfer the historical 2^(n-2) restriction frontier to the exact Policy-0A cache DAG while charging units, local proof events, terminal contradictions, and cache reuse.

remaining_theorem_gates.name: Encoding Normalization
remaining_theorem_gates.statement: Express the final lower bound in the actual graph-tautology CNF input length.

falsification_conditions: Produce a later parent-eligible pre-frontier exact key containing a non-tail bridge with non-singleton tail.
Produce a contradictory merged-tail birth whose all-source unit-reason closure excludes the bad lineage.
Produce a recursive child carrying a merged-tail bad bridge into a later exact key.
Produce a surviving singleton-tail lineage whose transition merges the tail or fails to merge a singleton head.
Produce a same-cut complementary double-bridge pair in a parent-eligible pre-frontier exact key.
Map exponentially many historical frontier restrictions to polynomially many exact residual keys.
Construct a polynomial JANUS-FC_local execution family for graph tautologies.
claim_boundary: C024 exhaustively closes the finite local-Resolution obstruction for 4<=n<=8. It has not proved the two temporal lemmas for arbitrary n, has not transferred the asymptotic graph-tautology Formula-Caching lower bound to the exact Policy-0A cache DAG, and does not resolve P versus NP.
